From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Lowe <ethan@edgeops.io>
Date: 2028-04-01T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Thanks for signing up — next steps

Hi Ethan,

Thanks for signing up for Redwood Inference. I’m Soojin — you should receive access to your trial project within the hour. To make next steps easy, pick whichever session fits your team:

• Quick product overview (30 min) — recommended if you want a high-level walkthrough and pricing basics
https://cal.redwood.ai/soojin/30min

• Technical deep-dive (45 min) — recommended if you want to hash out latency, throughput, and integrations with your infra (bring your engineer)
https://cal.redwood.ai/monica/45min

Both links will propose times in your local timezone. If you prefer, reply to this thread with a couple of time windows and my teammate Monica can book for you.

I’ve attached a short QuickstartGuide.pdf to help your engineers get a sandbox running before the call. If you’re already using specific cloud regions or have compliance questions, tell us in your reply and we’ll loop in the right person.

Cheers,
Soojin Lee
Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference
